articles.title: Quantum Computing vs Blockchain: Separating Myths From Reality
articles.summary: Quantum computing is described as a threat to the cryptographic algorithms that secure blockchain wallets and digital signatures. The piece is framed as a comparison between quantum computing and blockchain, focused on separating myths from reality. Based on the description, the key issue is security: if quantum computers advance enough, they could weaken some of the encryption and signing methods blockchain systems rely on.
